title: The time-pinned finder's tests cover new Date(t) with a clock value
why: lint/test_find_time_pinned.py pins only `Date()` for a JS bare Date, and has no case for `new Date(t)` where t holds a clock (timing-tests lane ([ended:lane:-timing-tests]), cited by Fix: lines in #2002's notes, 09:00 CST Nov 8).
note: Dropped 12:27 CST Nov 18 (consultant relay, sent 12:28 CST by its clock; a reversible pick the consultant took). The cases assert a 'calendar' finder category, and main's finder after PR 3650 has none: CATEGORIES is sleep, elapsed-assert, test-cap, wait-cap. PR 2094 and the PR 2086 it stacked on both closed unmerged. A new step can add calendar rows if the owner wants them.
